description: This file contains unit tests for the PlayerComponents class in the starboard media framework, specifically testing media playback scenarios such as preroll, normal playback, seeking, pausing, and EOS handling, using Google Test framework.

classes.name: PlayerComponentsTest
classes.description: A Google Test fixture class for testing PlayerComponents with various media files and configurations, including setup, playback control, seeking, and validation methods.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates media readers, player components, and initializes renderers.

methods.name: GetMediaTimeProvider
methods.description: Returns the media time provider from the player components.

methods.name: GetAudioRenderer
methods.description: Returns the audio renderer from the player components.

methods.name: GetVideoRenderer
methods.description: Returns the video renderer from the player components.

methods.name: IsPlaybackPrerolled
methods.description: Checks if both audio and video are prerolled.

methods.name: IsPlaybackEnded
methods.description: Checks if playback has ended for both audio and video.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified timestamp, updating internal state and buffers.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Starts playback.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses playback.

methods.name: SetPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: GetMediaTime
methods.description: Returns the current media time.

methods.name: IsPlaying
methods.description: Returns whether media is currently playing.

methods.name: GetCurrentAudioBufferTimestamp
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of the current audio buffer.

methods.name: GetCurrentVideoBufferTimestamp
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of the current video buffer.

methods.name: GetMaxWrittenBufferTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the maximum timestamp of written buffers.

methods.name: WriteDataUntilPrerolled
methods.description: Writes data until playback is prerolled or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WriteDataUntil
methods.description: Writes data until a specified timestamp or timeout.

methods.name: WriteDataAndEOS
methods.description: Writes data until a timestamp and then writes end-of-stream.

methods.name: WriteEOSDirectly
methods.description: Immediately writes end-of-stream for both audio and video.

methods.name: WaitUntilPlaybackEnded
methods.description: Blocks until playback has ended or timeout occurs.

methods.name: RenderAndProcessPendingJobs
methods.description: Performs rendering and processes pending jobs to keep the player running.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Callback for handling errors.

methods.name: OnPrerolled
methods.description: Callback when media is prerolled.

methods.name: OnEnded
methods.description: Callback when media playback ends.

methods.name: GetAudioInputBuffer
methods.description: Creates an input buffer for audio data.

methods.name: GetVideoInputBuffer
methods.description: Creates an input buffer for video data.

methods.name: RenderOnGlesContextThread
methods.description: Performs rendering operations on the GLES context thread.

methods.name: TryToWriteOneInputBuffer
methods.description: Attempts to write one input buffer to the renderer if conditions permit.
